text:
Fixed the markup closing-tag matching bug.

Root cause: opening tags were normalized via `Style.normalize`, but explicit closing tags were compared using their raw spelling. This made case differences and reordered style names fail to match.

Change: normalize explicit closing tag names before looking them up in the style stack.

Tests: `130 passed` for `tests/test_markup.py tests/test_text.py`.

final_text:
Fixed the markup closing-tag matching bug.

Root cause: opening tags were normalized via `Style.normalize`, but explicit closing tags were compared using their raw spelling. This made case differences and reordered style names fail to match.

Change: normalize explicit closing tag names before looking them up in the style stack.

Tests: `130 passed` for `tests/test_markup.py tests/test_text.py`.
